title: Copper and Silver
subtitle: What the materials mean
text: Copper is naturally antiseptic — it does not harbor disease. The Unstained have known this for generations. Oxidized copper holds an additional sacred status: copper that has fully patinated has done its job, absorbing all the corruption it could until it was consecrated by that service. A person carrying fully patinated copper survived long enough for it to reach that state. The copper earned its color by protecting them. Pale Silver — the Unstained's highest-tier material — does not occur in nature. It is consecrated copper, refined through purification ritual until it achieves a purer state. It must be made.
